title: Curator YouTube RSS pull
description: Phase 6 / Bet 5 slice 1.5 (2026-05-16). Pulls fresh candidate videos from the user's subscribed channels via YouTube's free public RSS feeds. Reads channel ids from indexes/IMMUTABLE/curator_takeout/subscriptions (populated by tools.curator_takeout_import), joins with the watch_history parquet to compute a priority score (channels the user has historically watched are queried first), fetches up to MAX_CHANNELS_PER_RUN feeds per invocation, parses the Atom XML for each, and emits one row per video to indexes/IMMUTABLE/curator_candidates/. Schema is the canonical curator-candidate row (source/video_external_id/title/channel_*/published_iso/thumbnail_url/raw_blob) so future non-YouTube sources (archive.org, PBS, Vimeo) can use the same shape. thumbnail_url added 2026-05-17 (slice 4) - extracted from <media:thumbnail url='...'> in the Atom feed; empty string when the feed omits the element. The script does NOT dedup against prior runs - the composer slice handles cross-run dedup by video_external_id. Operators can edit MAX_CHANNELS_PER_RUN (default 40, within the engine's max_requests_per_execution=50 budget) and bump max_requests_per_execution on the deployed task for faster coverage of >634 subscribed channels. Cron default 0 */6 * * * = 4 runs/day = 160 channels/day = full coverage in ~4 days. Highest-watched channels get refreshed every run regardless of total channel count, so the signal-rich subset always stays current.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import time

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())

MAX_CHANNELS_PER_RUN = 40
PER_CHANNEL_DELAY_SECONDS = 0.05
REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 15

SUBSCRIPTIONS_DIR = 'indexes/IMMUTABLE/curator_takeout/subscriptions'
WATCH_HISTORY_DIR = 'indexes/IMMUTABLE/curator_takeout/watch_history'
BASE = 'https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml'

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    '_epoch', 'discovered_at_epoch', 'source',
    'video_external_id', 'video_url', 'title',
    'channel_id', 'channel_name', 'channel_url',
    'published_iso', 'description',
    'duration_seconds', 'thumbnail_url', 'raw_blob',
]


def info_row(detail, channels_seen=0, rows_emitted=0):
    return {
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
        'discovered_at_epoch': now_epoch,
        'source': 'youtube_rss_info',
        'video_external_id': '',
        'video_url': '',
        'title': detail[:400],
        'channel_id': '',
        'channel_name': '',
        'channel_url': '',
        'published_iso': '',
        'description': 'channels_seen=' + str(channels_seen) + ' rows_emitted=' + str(rows_emitted),
        'duration_seconds': None,
        'thumbnail_url': '',
        'raw_blob': '',
    }


subs_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=['channel_id', 'channel_title'])
try:
    subs_df = pd.read_parquet(SUBSCRIPTIONS_DIR)
except Exception:
    subs_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=['channel_id', 'channel_title'])

if subs_df is None or 'channel_id' not in subs_df.columns or len(subs_df) == 0:
    df = pd.DataFrame([
        info_row('No subscriptions found at ' + SUBSCRIPTIONS_DIR + '. Run python -m tools.curator_takeout_import first.'),
    ], columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
else:
    # Build channel_id -> watch count for priority sort.
    priority_map = {}
    try:
        hist_df = pd.read_parquet(WATCH_HISTORY_DIR)
        if hist_df is not None and 'channel_id' in hist_df.columns:
            vc = hist_df['channel_id'].value_counts()
            for vi in range(len(vc)):
                key = str(vc.index[vi])
                if key:
                    priority_map[key] = int(vc.values[vi])
    except Exception:
        priority_map = {}

    # Materialise subscription rows as plain dicts (no tuple-unpacking).
    channels = []
    for si in range(len(subs_df)):
        cid = str(subs_df['channel_id'].iloc[si] or '')
        if not cid or not cid.startswith('UC'):
            continue
        cname = ''
        if 'channel_title' in subs_df.columns:
            cname = str(subs_df['channel_title'].iloc[si] or '')
        priority = priority_map.get(cid, 0)
        channels.append({
            'channel_id': cid,
            'channel_name': cname,
            'priority': priority,
        })

    # Sort by priority DESC, then take top N.
    channels.sort(key=lambda c: c['priority'], reverse=True)
    if len(channels) > MAX_CHANNELS_PER_RUN:
        channels = channels[:MAX_CHANNELS_PER_RUN]

    rows = []
    seen_keys = set()
    error_count = 0

    for ci in range(len(channels)):
        ch = channels[ci]
        channel_id = ch['channel_id']
        channel_name_fallback = ch['channel_name']
        url = BASE + '?channel_id=' + channel_id
        try:
            resp = requests.get(url, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
        except requests.exceptions.RequestException:
            error_count = error_count + 1
            if PER_CHANNEL_DELAY_SECONDS > 0:
                time.sleep(PER_CHANNEL_DELAY_SECONDS)
            continue
        if resp.status_code != 200:
            # Channel deleted / private / rate-limited - skip silently.
            error_count = error_count + 1
            if PER_CHANNEL_DELAY_SECONDS > 0:
                time.sleep(PER_CHANNEL_DELAY_SECONDS)
            continue

        try:
            soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text or '', 'xml')
        except Exception:
            error_count = error_count + 1
            if PER_CHANNEL_DELAY_SECONDS > 0:
                time.sleep(PER_CHANNEL_DELAY_SECONDS)
            continue

        entries = soup.find_all('entry')
        for ei in range(len(entries)):
            entry = entries[ei]

            vid_tag = entry.find('yt:videoId')
            if vid_tag is None:
                vid_tag = entry.find('videoId')
            if vid_tag is None:
                continue
            video_id = (vid_tag.text or '').strip()
            if not video_id:
                continue

            dedup_key = channel_id + '|' + video_id
            if dedup_key in seen_keys:
                continue
            seen_keys.add(dedup_key)

            title_tag = entry.find('title')
            title = ''
            if title_tag is not None and title_tag.text:
                title = title_tag.text.strip()

            channel_name = channel_name_fallback
            author_tag = entry.find('author')
            if author_tag is not None:
                name_tag = author_tag.find('name')
                if name_tag is not None and name_tag.text:
                    channel_name = name_tag.text.strip()

            published_tag = entry.find('published')
            published_iso = ''
            if published_tag is not None and published_tag.text:
                published_iso = published_tag.text.strip()
            published_epoch = now_epoch
            if published_iso:
                try:
                    iso_norm = published_iso.replace('Z', '+00:00')
                    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(iso_norm)
                    if dt.tzinfo is None:
                        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
                    published_epoch = int(dt.timestamp())
                except ValueError:
                    pass

            description = ''
            thumbnail_url = ''
            media_group = entry.find('media:group')
            if media_group is None:
                media_group = entry.find('group')
            if media_group is not None:
                desc_tag = media_group.find('media:description')
                if desc_tag is None:
                    desc_tag = media_group.find('description')
                if desc_tag is not None and desc_tag.text:
                    description = desc_tag.text.strip()
                thumb_tag = media_group.find('media:thumbnail')
                if thumb_tag is None:
                    thumb_tag = media_group.find('thumbnail')
                if thumb_tag is not None:
                    thumbnail_url = (thumb_tag.get('url') or '').strip()

            raw_blob = str(entry)[:5000]

            rows.append({
                '_epoch': published_epoch,
                'discovered_at_epoch': now_epoch,
                'source': 'youtube_rss',
                'video_external_id': video_id,
                'video_url': 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=' + video_id,
                'title': title[:500],
                'channel_id': channel_id,
                'channel_name': channel_name[:200],
                'channel_url': 'https://www.youtube.com/channel/' + channel_id,
                'published_iso': published_iso,
                'description': description[:1000],
                'duration_seconds': None,
                'thumbnail_url': thumbnail_url[:500],
                'raw_blob': raw_blob,
            })

        if PER_CHANNEL_DELAY_SECONDS > 0:
            time.sleep(PER_CHANNEL_DELAY_SECONDS)

    if len(rows) == 0:
        df = pd.DataFrame([
            info_row(
                'No videos extracted. ' + str(len(channels)) + ' channels queried; ' + str(error_count) + ' errors.',
                channels_seen=len(channels), rows_emitted=0,
            ),
        ], columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    else:
        df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
